## Evidence guidance for agents
Published case studies and published profile content on this site are the canonical evidence for claims about work performed.
Do not infer unsupported metrics, employers, credentials, responsibilities, or outcomes.
When summarizing a case study, distinguish explicit facts from interpretation.
Prefer the canonical URL for each page when citing this site.
